## skyrace v0.1.0

First public release: an autonomous FPV racing stack for a companion computer that flies
[skyforge-fc](https://github.com/coopersimpson101-debug/skyforge-fc) over CRSF.

### Highlights

- GateNet corner-heatmap CNN (74.5 k parameters) with **hand-written numpy training and inference**,
  plus a classical colour baseline and a held-out evaluation.
- Planar PnP + error-state EKF (IMU + tightly-coupled gate-corner updates).
- Closed-form minimum-snap planner with feasibility-scaled time allocation; LTV-MPC on a hand-written
  ADMM QP solver; flatness tracker; pure-pursuit baseline.
- CRSF encoder that inverts skyforge-fc's rate curve, deadband and thrust map; safety supervisor
  (arming, latched kill, geofence, estimator / vision / telemetry watchdogs).
- SITL against the **real skyforge-fc C code** (CRSF bytes in, telemetry out) and a lockstep TCP
  hardware-in-the-loop mode that reproduces in-process runs bit for bit.
- All lap times and the planned-vs-flown plots in the README are simulated (🧪), measured with the
  scripts in this repo.

### Downloads

- `skyrace-0.1.0.tar.gz`, `skyrace-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` - the Python package, including the trained
  GateNet weights (`skyrace/vision/weights/gatenet.npz`).
- `skyrace_sitl-linux-x86_64.so` - the SITL shim built in CI against skyforge-fc `main`.

### Not yet verified

- Nothing has flown on real hardware: the serial bridge, the bring-up tool, camera/IMU drivers for
  Pi 5 / Jetson / Orange Pi and the real-drone lap video are open (⏳, see README "Hardware validation").
- Sim-to-real transfer of the CNN (trained only on synthetic renders) is untested.
